message: The islands here float! They're called phumdis: rings of plants and soil. One holds a whole national park, home of the sangai deer.

field_find.name: Sangai deer
field_find.note: A deer found in the wild only on the floating park of Keibul Lamjao.

alt: Loktak Lake with rings of floating green islands and hills behind.
